entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I need to... I think I need to return something? It's a VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you provide me with the order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, I don't even know. It's all just been so much. My husband bought it for me, but right after it arrived we had an emergency. He's in the military and his deployment was suddenly moved up.
I'm very sorry to hear that. That must be difficult.

It was. And then I had to go to the hospital myself for a minor surgery I couldn't put off. I just got home a few days ago and found the box. The policy on the website was so confusing... I couldn't make sense of it. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Sarah. I completely understand, and I'm sorry you had to deal with all of that. Let me just check the return window for you. One moment.

Okay, I've checked our policy. It looks like your purchase was 36 days ago. VeloFit has a 10-day return window, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not at all. I'm happy to help. I'm generating a prepaid return label now and sending it to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days.
Thank you, Charlie. You've made this so much easier. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
